blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Port Moody townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for townhomes in Port Moody was $940,900 in September 2026 (-5.2% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Port Moody townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

111 townhomes sold in Port Moody with a median price of $945,000 (the middle half sold between $826,000 and $1,179,000), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $599 per square foot, a median year built of 1992 and a median strata fee of $479 a month.

blocks.text: Port Moody Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Townhome stock concentrates in Klahanie (Klahanie Drive, off Barnet Highway), Suter Brook (Morrissey Road) and the St. Johns Street corridor.
The Moody Centre Station Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) Area runs from the Canadian Pacific Railway line to St. Johns Street, Electronic Avenue to Moody Street.

blocks.text: Port Moody Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Klahanie is Polygon's master-planned community on Klahanie Drive: townhome and apartment residences facing Burrard Inlet, sharing one amenity building, The Canoe Club.
Boardwalk at Klahanie, 600 and 700 Klahanie Drive, is apartment product in the same master plan — a Klahanie address alone does not say townhouse or condo.
Suter Brook's anchor is The Grande, 300 Morrissey Road, a 26-storey condominium tower by Onni; townhouse-form stock sits in the low-rise buildings around it.
The Moody Centre TOD Area is planned for buildings up to 26 storeys, so new ground-oriented product there arrives as podium townhouse units inside larger projects.

blocks.text: Port Moody Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Since 2024 the provincial Transit-Oriented Area rules (Bill 47) set minimum densities around Moody Centre Station: up to 20 storeys within 200 metres, 12 within 400 metres, 8 within 800 metres.
Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw, 2026, No. 3522, Chapter 14 groups Heritage Mountain with Twin Creeks, Noons Creek, Mountain Meadows and Heritage Woods, separately from the station areas.
Tree removal on a development site needs a permit and arborist report under Tree Protection Bylaw, 2026, No.
Province-wide: long-term rental-restriction bylaws are unenforceable since November 24, 2022; the only enforceable age bylaw is 55-plus (55+).

blocks.text: Port Moody Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Shoreline Park's trail network runs about 6 kilometres along the Burrard Inlet shore below Klahanie, linking Rocky Point Park eastward.
Suter Brook Village and Newport Village, either side of Ioco Road, are the two planned shopping villages serving this stock.
The Moody Centre TOD vision dates to 2017; the 2024 provincial Transit-Oriented Area designation (Bill 47) now overlays the City's framework on the same ground.
South of St. Johns Street is a designated Special Study Area in the OCP — studied for change, not yet re-planned.
Klahanie's building names (The Tides, Salal, Inglenook) repeat across phases — the strata plan number, not the building name, identifies the legal complex.

blocks.text: Port Moody Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: 3541 sets the 2026 municipal general rate at 1.61574 per $1,000, plus police 0.70211 and asset renewal 0.24678; taxes were due July 2, 2026.
The 2026 single-family utility bill (water, sewer, garbage, green waste, recycling) is $1,892, due February 27, 2026; strata figures are set complex by complex.
Port Moody is a listed taxable area for the provincial Speculation and Vacancy Tax; owners must declare annually.

blocks.text: Port Moody Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Moody Centre Station is the transit hinge: Millennium Line SkyTrain, West Coast Express platform and bus exchange share one site south of the tracks.
Inlet Centre Station, at Barnet Highway and Ioco Road, is closest to Klahanie's east end and Suter Brook.
Barnet Highway (Highway 7A) is the driving spine; St. Johns Street carries Moody Centre traffic one block south of the tracks.

blocks.text: Port Moody Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Klahanie's first phases date to the mid-2000s, inside the mandatory depreciation-report cycle; read the report's funding models against the contingency reserve fund on the Form B.
Hillside complexes back onto Noons Creek and Twin Creeks ravines: confirm creek setbacks and the Tree Protection Bylaw, 2026, No. 3531 position before exterior work.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Port Moody sell for?
faq.a: 111 townhomes sold in Port Moody between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $945,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Port Moody?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.0% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in Port Moody sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 111 townhomes that sold in Port Moody went for between $826,000 and $1,179,000, around a median of $945,000.

faq.q: Do townhomes in Port Moody sell above asking price?
faq.a: 3% of the 111 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 98.0% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in Port Moody?
faq.a: Of the 111 sales, 110 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $479.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in Port Moody?
faq.a: The median year built was 1992 for the 111 townhomes sold in Port Moody.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in Port Moody usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Port Moody had 3 bedrooms, from the 111 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Moody communities sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Port Moody Centre (31), College Park PM (27), North Shore Pt Moody (21), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Port Moody buildings sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Easthill (8), Woodside Village (5), Eagle Point (5), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in Port Moody?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in Port Moody was $940,900 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in Port Moody?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 5.2%. Over three months it fell 5.3%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Port Moody a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026 houses in Port Moody had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 20%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Port Moody?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in Port Moody that match what you want.
